_comment: Linked Library spec §5: every sidecar kind, how to build one for a new source file and how to check it. The upkeep loop's rebuild-sidecar playbook reads this; adding a kind is one entry. Commands run from the repo root; {zim} is the new source file, {out} the output folder. gvec and gtime keep their own playbooks (rebuild-vectors, rebuild-timeindex) until the catalog moves them into sidecars (after Plan SQ).

gqid.inputs: wdfilter.py's items-<site>.jsonl for the pack's language, on /Volumes/X10 Pro/granger-ll/ (rebuilt from a newer Wikidata dump at most quarterly)
